title: Comparative outcomes of DSAEK and DMEK in eyes with prior Ahmed glaucoma valve implantation

license.statement: CC BY 4.0 (article <license>: Creative Commons Attribution License, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)

indication: Endothelial keratoplasty in eyes with a prior Ahmed glaucoma valve (single or multiple AGV, some with prior trabeculectomy/MIGS; POAG, secondary, uveitic, pseudoexfoliative, neovascular glaucoma, ICE syndrome); no previous corneal transplantation; mostly pseudophakic

groups.description: Ultrathin DSAEK (precut eye-bank tissue, mean graft thickness about 58 um, pull-through insertion, air tamponade); surgeon's choice of technique; retrospective consecutive series
DMEK (precut, preloaded eye-bank grafts in glass tubes, air tamponade); surgeon's choice of technique; retrospective consecutive series

series.baseline_label: Reference = donor ECD (Table 3 row 'Donor'); donor tissue precut and supplied by a nonprofit eye bank (Methods)
series.notes: Table 3 column 'DSAEK (n = 16)'; mean ± standard deviation. n_by_time: header n for the donor, 1- and 3-month rows; footnotes ‡ (6 months, n = 16) and § (12 months, n = 14); Results: eyes with graft failure by a visit were excluded from that visit's analysis.

series.baseline_label: Reference = donor ECD (Table 3 row 'Donor'); donor tissue precut and preloaded by a nonprofit eye bank (Methods)
series.notes: Table 3 column 'DMEK (n = 11)'; mean ± standard deviation. n_by_time: header n for the donor, 1- and 3-month rows; footnotes ‡ (6 months, n = 10) and § (12 months, n = 10); Results: eyes with graft failure by a visit were excluded from that visit's analysis.

exclusions.what: Table 4 percent endothelial cell loss (%ECL relative to donor ECD)
exclusions.reason: The same groups have absolute ECD in Table 3; the absolute ECD series are used

exclusions.what: Table 3 'Mean Difference (95% CI)' and 'P value' columns
exclusions.reason: Between-group differences and p-values are not admissible
Same donor values as Table 3; Table 3 cells are cited for the whole series

notes: DSAEK and DMEK are two standard techniques chosen by surgeon preference, no investigational agent: both control-role groups with per-group procedure contexts (dsaek, dmek).

Failed grafts were removed from later visits (5/16 DSAEK and 3/11 DMEK secondary failures overall); the group itself is defined by procedure, not by a postoperative outcome, so it is kept and the attrition is shown in n_by_time.
The method used to count donor ECD is not described beyond the eye-bank supply of the tissue.
